text:
nadia: Quick threadWe need to decide publishing layout for the JS SDK. Options: single package with conditional exports vs two packages (sdk + sdk-cjs). Main blockers: edge-only runtimes (ESM) + lots of older Node users (require). Also onboarding sample apps are confusing for customers who hit types resolution errors. Anyone who wants single-package vs split?

ryan: I lean single-package. Fewer GH releases, simpler docs. Conditional exports are the tricky part but doable. We must add very explicit fallbacks for bundlers. Also add a dev smoke matrix to catch resolver quirks.

harpreet: Single-package okay, but we must explicitly document runtime differences for auth and retries. Edge GPUs/edge functions cannot use node TLS/KMS helpers or socket keepalive. Our retry logic needs to be opt-in for edge or at least limited to idempotent methods. We had a Vercel customer hit duplicate side-effects because retries were identical.

nadia: On types: TS projects sometimes pick up esm build d.ts while CJS picks dist d.ts and that breaks path imports. Would it be safer to point "types" at ./dist/index.d.ts and use "typesVersions" to map older TS to specific paths?

ryan: typesVersions helps. Example snippet that passed our internal smoke tests:
```json
{
  "main": "./cjs/index.js",
  "module": "./esm/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./esm/index.js",
      "require": "./cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

harpreet: For edge shim, consider shipping a tiny file at ./edge/index.js and an exports subpath like "./edge": { "import": "./edge/index.js" } so bundlers that support subpath imports can pick it up. Document that it uses fetch and excludes node-only auth helpers.

publish-bot: Heads up: splitting into two packages doubles patch work and CVE tracking. Ops strongly prefers single-package unless the developer experience suffers.

ci-bot: CI note: the conditional exports matrix is flaky across node 16/18/20 and different npm versions. Pinning runners to node 18/20 in the matrix reduced flakiness in our tests. Also add a runtime smoke that does: `node -e "require('./cjs/index.js')"` and an esm runner `node --input-type=module -e "import('./esm/index.js')"` to the matrix.

ryan: Additional thing: include index.cjs and index.mjs at package root that just re-export into dist. Old tools sometimes look for those. That plus a minimal exports map seems to please bundlers and older consumers.

nadia: Good call. Also let's add a tiny sample app repo 'examples/sdk-node-cjs' and 'examples/sdk-edge' that we can link from quickstart so users can copy/paste. The onboarding friction is mostly from broken examples in README.

samir: I'll prototype single-package with: dual root entry files, explicit exports map, types -> ./dist/index.d.ts, plus an examples/ folder and a test harness that runs CJS/ESM/Edge smoke tests. I'll open a WIP PR and tag this thread. Assigning to myself, ETA EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
